name: Fairfax County Camp Counselors In Training (C.I.T.)
org: Fairfax County Park Authority / Neighborhood and Community Services

offerings.cycle_label: Summer 2023 (most recent cycle on this page)
offerings.summary: Teens aged 14 and up assist camp counsellors with programming for primary-school children, building teamwork, communication and leadership skills.

loc.venue: Fairfax County camps and Rec-PAC sites

age.raw: open to teens ages 14 and older

items.raw: there is an application fee and initial online training that must be completed

comp.raw: Unpaid; participants receive a T-shirt only

sched.schedule_raw: Rec-PAC: in-person training June 17; work June 26 to Aug. 3, 8:15 a.m.-4 p.m. weekdays

reqs.raw: initial online training that must be completed

issues: The only Park Authority page carrying C.I.T. details is a news item from April 2023. The programme is the in-scope counterpart to the 18-and-over camp counsellor jobs, so it needs a current source before publication.
An application fee is required but the amount is not published
